text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened when we were doing
joint training with Nice Nature and the others.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Alright...!
I might have saved... enough in my legs until the very end...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, wasn't that just perfection?
The pacing, the timing of the surge...
Who would've thought she'd still have that much left on the final stretch?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Shion's running is marrrvelousâââ
Zooming ahead and going KA-BOOOOMâââ

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um... you think so...?
...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, while cleaning up...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
choice_data_list: You're in a good mood, huh, Shion.
You're in a good mood, Shion.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? Ah...!
Am I... spinning...!?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Nnnrgh!!
Id-Idiot-cation! What am I getting so giddy about...!
choice_data_list: That was a beautiful pirouette, wasn't it?
Still, it's dangerous to walk around while cleaning up, so...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Nnnrgh!!
Id-Idiot-cation! What am I getting so giddy about...!
choice_data_list: That was a beautiful pirouette, wasn't it?
Still, it's dangerous to walk around while cleaning up, so...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, no, no!
You don't need to praise me...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I thought it looked great too, you know?
Shion-san's pirouette."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Her movements were super sharp, you know?
Even to an amateur like me, it was obvious how amazing she was~.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh? Come on, you're exaggerating...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a face red as an apple,
Win Variation waved her hand.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Your core was rock solid☆★☆
Even more twirly-twirl than before, maaarvelous★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then, watching it makes me so bubbly☆★☆
Shion's pirouette is a pirouette of happiness★☆★

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Of happiness—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
I'll go put the equipment back in the shed, ssus!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
Does my face look all floppy and weird...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“Still, a pirouette of happiness, huh...
......Ehehe.”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're right...!
I'm sorry, I'll be more careful.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I need to cool my head a bit...
...Deep breath in... and out...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking a deep breath to calm down,
Win Variation went back to tidying up.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...!
I'm so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Not once, but twice now...
I have to keep myself grounded and not get carried away...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation braced herself once more
and went back to tidying up.
